title: Voikov to Stomoniakov, numbers 01135-35283, Moscow to Berlin, 1 June 1921 (NARA M316 roll 42, frame 1272)

plaintext.source: No decipherment in the file; Bristol reports none.

transcription.source: NARA M316 frame, RG 64 digital copy
transcription.notes: Two parts around an interference gap of about 42 letters.

system.summary: A columnar transposition of Russian in Latin letters: frequencies are Russian with no substitution, and the recovered key gives Russian text. Q is the soft or hard sign; punctuation is spelled out.

prior_solution.where: GC&CS read other Soviet links in 1921 (Tiltman); HW 12 and RG 457 6707N not seen; no reading of this message found

conditions.human_role: Named the catalogue entry and asked to keep attacking the letter traffic.
tools: lang engine with a Russian corpus from ru.wikipedia

solution.what: Fetched the OCR of the M316 reels and found runs of 5-letter groups, then fetched the frame image.
The letter traffic to Stomoniakov (2,310 letters, OCR) has Russian letter frequencies with no substitution.
Same indicator as Nr 1883, so same key: every gap from 0 to 120 scored -4.97 at best, near random keys.
Own key at width 20, gap about 42: -3.09; opens prod, same vocabulary, some columns still misplaced.

outcome.method_basis: Key partly recovered; the decode does not yet form sentences.
outcome.notes: Continuation of voikov1921 by its opening, with a different key.
